sources.summary: New Jersey's lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was forced to resign on September 25th after an investigation found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name. But he took a particularly odd tactic during an interview on NJ […]
sources.summary_zh: 新澤西州副州長戴爾・考德威爾（Dale Caldwell）於 9 月 25 日被迫辭職，此前一項調查發現他對一名幕僚進行性騷擾，並多次違反道德規範。這位前副州長一直在各大媒體亮相，試圖洗刷自己的清白。但他在接受 NJ […] 採訪時採取了一種特別奇怪的策略
